lines.text: The grey service door. The one you came in through, where the plan says it is.
There you are. Fine. I was tired. I was anxious and I walked past it.
Relief arrives all at once: the guard, the returned box, the wet yard eleven seconds away. Your exit is incoming.
It is right there and it does not open. And then it is not right there — a foot to the left, and then a wall.
You did not vanquish me. There is no version of this where you vanquish me. I am the room.
The door goes on not being where the door is. Your waypoint blinks out, and re-draws, pointing somewhere you never marked.
